主要内容: Brown Gibbons Lang & Company (BGL) released a report highlighting LED lighting's transformative impact on the industry. LED technology is driving rapid market penetration due to energy savings, longer life, and improving light quality. M&A activity remains high as companies leverage acquisitions to build scale and adopt intelligent lighting solutions. In May, Philips announced plans to sell at least 25% of its Lighting Division via IPO. Acuity Brands acquired Juno Lighting for $385 million at a 12.0x EBITDA multiple. Private equity firms have also shown interest, with several notable platform acquisitions. BGL, an independent investment bank, provides M&A advisory and capital raising services across multiple sectors. The report underscores the growing demand for connected lighting systems and the convergence of LED lighting with controls to enable integrated networks.
